map.是否存在已知 DIC 相关基础疾病？: Is there a known DIC-related underlying disease?
map.是（败血症/创伤/产科急症/恶性肿瘤等）: Yes (sepsis / trauma / obstetric emergency / malignancy, etc.)
map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分：总分 ≥5 分提示显性 DIC，需重复评估: ISTH overt DIC score: total ≥5 suggests overt DIC, needs repeat assessment
map.评分 <5 分提示非显性 DIC，建议 24-48 小时后复查: Score <5 suggests non-overt DIC, recheck after 24-48 hours
map.3P试验阳性提示存在可溶性纤维蛋白单体复合物（SFMC），支持 DIC 诊断: A positive 3P test suggests soluble fibrin monomer complex (SFMC), supporting DIC diagnosis
map.结果仅供参考，DIC 诊断需结合临床表现和动态监测: Results are for reference only; DIC diagnosis needs clinical picture and dynamic monitoring
map.📚 深度解析：DIC（3P试验/FDP）评分: 📚 Deep Dive: DIC (3P test / FDP) Score
map.用 ISTH 显性 DIC 评分（血小板/D-二聚体/PT/纤维蛋白原）判 DI: Use the ISTH overt DIC score (platelets / D-dimer / PT / fibrinogen) to judge DIC.
map.结合 3P 试验与 FDP 补充纤维蛋白单体与纤溶信息: Combine the 3P test and FDP to add fibrin monomer and fibrinolysis information.
map.≥5 显性 DIC 启动替代+抗凝，<5 非显性动态复查: ≥5 overt DIC starts replacement + anticoagulation; <5 non-overt, dynamic recheck.
map.ISTH 评分：血小板<50(+2)、50–100(+1)；D-二聚体>10(+: ISTH score: platelets <50 (+2), 50-100 (+1); D-dimer >10 (+3), 5-10 (+2), >1 (+1); PT prolongation >6s (+2), 3-6s (+1); fibrinogen <1.0 (+1). Prerequisite: a DIC underlying disease; ≥5 overt DIC, <5 non-overt. Added: a positive 3P suggests soluble fibrin monomer (SFMC), raised FDP supports hyperfibrinolysis.
map.例（血小板=45、D-二聚体=8.5、PT 延长=5s、纤维蛋白原=0.9）：血: Example (platelets=45, D-dimer=8.5, PT prolongation=5s, fibrinogen=0.9): platelets <50 (+2), D-dimer 5-10 (+2), PT 3-6s (+1), fibrinogen <1.0 (+1) → ISTH = 6 → overt DIC; treat the underlying disease and give platelets / cryoprecipitate / FFP, with anticoagulation if needed.
map.3P 试验阳性一定 DIC 吗？: Does a positive 3P test always mean DIC?
map.不一定。3P 阳性提示存在可溶性纤维蛋白单体，支持 DIC 但敏感性与特异性有限: Not necessarily. A positive 3P suggests soluble fibrin monomer, supporting DIC but with limited sensitivity and specificity; late hyperfibrinolysis or prolonged sample standing can give false negative/positive, so combine with the ISTH score and clinical picture.
map.不能。DIC 早期纤维蛋白原可因肝病/炎症升高而掩盖；动态下降或持续<1.0 g: No. In early DIC fibrinogen can be raised by liver disease / inflammation and mask the drop; a dynamic fall or persistently <1.0 g/L is more meaningful, so recheck and combine with the D-dimer trend.

map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分工具，基于血小板计数、D-二聚体、PT延长值、纤维蛋: An ISTH overt DIC scoring tool: it scores standardisedly from four indicators — platelet count, D-dimer, PT prolongation and fibrinogen — and, with FDP and 3P results, judges whether the overt DIC criteria are met and gives treatment advice.
